issue.title: The retry button ignores the selected delay
issue.body: Invented example: choose a longer retry delay, save the settings, and trigger a retry. The next attempt still starts after the shortest delay.

expected.brief_md: Make the configured retry delay apply to the next attempt.

issue.title: Long status labels overflow on narrow screens
issue.body: Invented example: on a narrow window, a long status label extends past its card instead of wrapping.

expected.brief_md: Keep long status labels inside their card on narrow screens.

issue.title: A corrected form keeps the old validation message
issue.body: Invented example: submit an invalid value, correct it, and submit again. The form succeeds but leaves the earlier error message visible.

expected.brief_md: Clear stale validation feedback after a corrected form submission succeeds.

issue.title: Restore production sign-in after a configuration regression
issue.body: Invented example: all users are currently unable to sign in because an existing runtime feature flag was accidentally disabled. Turn that flag back on, preserving the current authentication behavior.

issue.title: Keep workspace settings in sync across panels
issue.body: Invented example: changing a workspace preference should update every settings panel that displays it. The shared TypeScript symbol SettingsController.updatePreferences is affected, but its upstream impact is unconfirmed.

issue.title: Verify workspace membership before exporting records
issue.body: Invented example: the workspace export endpoint accepts a caller-supplied workspace_id and returns records without checking the caller's membership. Add the missing tenant authorization check while preserving valid exports.
